implementation.note: Repaired Mac consumer includes, parity prerequisites, Python selection and license packaging.

architecture.note: Existing CMake targets and the existing test registry retain ownership.

native_api.note: The patch changes build inputs and verification commands.

skill.note: The patch adds no authoring operation.

studio.note: The native Studio dependency changes only its compilation.

inspector.note: There are no new editable properties.

graphs.note: No graph schema or operation changes.

performance.note: Compiler inputs and test process selection have no new runtime workload.

platforms.note: Local Apple Silicon Release bundles and Debug tests exercised the packaging and runner changes.

dependencies.note: Studio and the standalone client compile with the vendored Box3D headers. The runner reuses the configured Python.

headless.note: There is no new simulation behavior. Existing parity coverage is documented in the handoff.

examples.note: The existing runner and package templates exercise the repaired paths.

tests.note: The regression suite exercises configured interpreter paths, runner failures and registry arguments. The handoff also records native, web and parity results.

handoff.note: The build handoff identifies source revisions, failures, commands and artifacts.

documentation.note: The build roadmap and runner handoff record the delivery.

publishing.note: This build repair adds no visible feature or public release.
